We are looking for a skilled craftsman who will drive the visual language of solutions to our users problems. You are a master of your craft, you know when to follow UI kits or when to evolve them, always structured and consistent. You know how to create amazing layouts and typographic lock ups, and you know the"magic" numbers, from your leading to kerning to opacity, to those special greys.

We are small product design studio based in London working with industry leading clients who invest in user-centered design and recognise it’s strategic value for the business. Industries include mapping, automotive, internet of things and imaging.

Approach to work

  • work from deep insight into user’s needs and behaviour and translate those into UI ideas and elegant visuals
  • work as part of team of expert designers who previously worked at Google, Sony and Microsoft
  • evolve best practices by learning from each other and responding to unique challenges of each project
  • practice the craft and get better at what you love doing
  • flexible and remote working
  • learn about maps, cartography and data visualisation
  • solve business problems through design

Deliverables

  • you’ll work on overall design look and feel, based on the product architecture and wireframes
  • explore different visual approaches that might be evaluated with target users
  • detailed visual design for UI components and states
  • defined approach to color, typography, iconography and layout

Experience

  • Defining and translate branding in to product visual design systems
  • Web services and user interfaces
  • iOS and Android user interface

At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

About Our Team

Visual Design turns complex financial products into experiences customers can understand, trust, and remember. Through motion, illustration, and visual storytelling, we connect brand promise to product reality, bringing clarity and cohesion to every moment, from discovery and onboarding to everyday use.
We partner with Product Design, Brand, Content Design, Engineering, and Product Marketing to create expressive, accessible, and scalable experiences across Affirm’s ecosystem. Our role is to elevate the quality of execution, build visual systems that help teams move with consistency, and use craft to guide attention, explain value, and create moments of confidence and delight. We ensure Affirm does not simply work well - it communicates clearly, feels unmistakably our own, and earns customer trust at every touchpoint.

About the Role

We’re looking for a motion-forward Visual Designer who brings strong craft in animation, visual storytelling, and illustration. You’ll help elevate the quality and consistency of customer experiences across Affirm’s product ecosystem, using motion to guide attention, explain product behavior, improve comprehension, and create moments of clarity and delight.

This role sits at the intersection of product and brand. Your work will range from in-product interactions and animated illustrations to web, email communications, lifecycle journeys, and product launches. You’ll pair deep motion and visual-design craft with UX thinking and an understanding of design systems to create experiences that are cohesive, accessible, scalable, and purposeful.

You think holistically about end-to-end customer journeys, care deeply about craft, and understand how thoughtful motion and visual systems can make experiences both functional and emotionally engaging.

What You’ll Do

  • Design motion-forward experiences across in-app surfaces, web, email, lifecycle comms, and product marketing, with a focus on clarity, accessibility, performance, and storytelling.
  • Create animations, motion studies, animated illustrations, iconography, and interaction patterns that explain product behavior, guide attention, and improve customer comprehension.
  • Own defined visual and motion-design projects from concept and storyboarding through production and implementation, maintaining a consistently high level of craft.
  • Contribute to product-design initiatives by mapping user flows, developing interaction concepts, and carrying solutions through high-fidelity design and prototyping.
  • Create and extend reusable visual assets, motion patterns, guidelines, and components that strengthen Affirm’s product and communication systems.
  • Collaborate with Product Design, Design Systems, Product, Engineering, Brand, Content Design, Lifecycle, and Growth partners to deliver cohesive end-to-end experiences.
  • Prepare production-ready assets and specifications, partnering with engineers to ensure motion and visual details are accessible, performant, and implemented as intended.

What We Look For

  • 3+ years of professional experience in motion, animation, visual, communication, or product design within a product-driven environment.
  • A portfolio demonstrating strong motion and visual-design craft, including animation, interaction, illustration, and storytelling across digital product experiences.
  • Strong knowledge of animation principles, including timing, pacing, easing, transitions, and choreography, and proficiency with tools such as After Effects, LottieFiles, Rive, or comparable software.
  • Mastery of tools including Figma, Adobe Creative Suite, After Effects, LottieFiles, and relevant 2D/3D animation tools.
  • Familiarity with HTML/CSS and the technical constraints of production environments (especially in email and mobile).
  • UX and product-design experience, including an understanding of user flows, interaction design, information hierarchy, and how motion can support an end-to-end experience.
  • Ability to storyboard, prototype, and articulate design decisions to technical and non-technical audiences alike.
  • Ability to independently deliver defined projects, communicate design rationale, incorporate feedback, and collaborate effectively with designers, engineers, marketers, and other cross-functional partners.

Pay Grade - J

Equity Grade - 4

Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range. Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job-related skills.

Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents). In addition, the employees may be eligible for equity rewards offered by Affirm Holdings, Inc. (parent company).

CAN base pay range per year: $101,000 - $151,000

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

Remote-first with flexibility built inAffirm is proud to be a remote-first company. Most roles can be done from almost anywhere within the country of employment. Some positions may occasionally require in-person work at an Affirm office, and a few are office-based due to the nature of the work. All new hires will be invited to attend an in-person onboarding experience.

Benefits designed for youOur benefits reflect our commitment to care, transparency, and flexibility. Here are a few highlights:

  • Health coverage at no cost: We cover 100% of premiums for employees and their dependents.
  • Spending stipends: Monthly stipends support your tech setup, and the ability to choose health and wellness options that are right for you.
  • Time off to recharge: Flexible time off and generous holiday calendars help you rest when you need to.
  • Own a piece of what you build: Our employee stock purchase plan (ESPP) lets you buy Affirm stock at a discount.

We’re committed to providing an inclusive interview process, including accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you need support, we’re happy to help.

For positions based in San Francisco or Los Angeles: Affirm considers qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records, as required by law.

By clicking "Submit Application," you acknowledge that you have read Affirm's Global Candidate Privacy Notice and consent to the use of your personal information as described.

Fuse Energy is an energy startup on a mission to make energy abundant and affordable, fast. We combine first-principles thinking with cutting-edge technology to build a radically better energy system.

We've raised over $200M from top-tier investors including Balderton, Lakestar, Accel, Creandum, Lowercarbon, Ribbit, 20VC, Hummingbird and Collaborative Fund, alongside strategic angels including Nico Rosberg and GPs behind Meta, Revolut, Spotify and Uber.

We're building a fully integrated energy company: developing our own solar, batteries and other generation projects, building our own hardware, improving and developing grid infrastructure, trading power in real time, using AI across the business, and installing distributed energy in homes. By selling directly to consumers we cut out the middleman, lower costs and pass the savings on to our customers.

As a Visual/Motion Designer, you bring product and hardware reveals, title sequences, brand films and animations for social and campaign moments to life. With hardware, robotics and our own generation to build, there's an unusual amount of great 3D and motion to work with here.

Responsibilities

  • Create high-quality 2D and 3D motion design for marketing campaigns, performance ads, product reveals, social content, and digital experiences
  • Build the visual look and treatment for key brand moments, from title sequences and motion systems to cinematic product animations
  • Create functional product visualizations that help customers understand complex products and conceptual campaign work that brings abstract ideas to life through compelling visual storytelling
  • Design custom 3D assets, illustrations, icons, and characters that strengthen product storytelling and elevate the Fuse Energy brand
  • Take ownership of projects from brief to delivery, proactively contributing creative ideas, visual concepts, and solutions
  • Collaborate closely with product, growth, content, and engineering teams to deliver cohesive, high-quality creative work
  • Use audience insights and creative testing to continuously refine and improve visual content
  • Maintain a consistently high level of craft and visual quality across every brand touchpoint

Requirements

  • 5+ years in motion design, 3D or visual design, with a portfolio showing exceptional craft across campaigns, products or digital experiences
  • Strong motion and 3D skills, with excellent visual taste and a keen eye for composition, lighting, materials, typography and storytelling
  • A proactive, self-directed mindset: you take ownership, think independently and contribute creative ideas rather than simply executing briefs
  • A creative problem solver who can translate complex products and abstract concepts into clear, compelling visual stories
  • Excitement for technology, hardware and building memorable product experiences through motion and 3D
  • Bonus: product visualisation or digital products, particularly optimised assets for real-time applications

Benefits

  • Competitive salary and eligibility for equity
  • Biannual bonus scheme
  • Fully expensed tech to match your needs
  • Private health insurance
  • Breakfast and dinner allowance for office-based employees

As we hire globally, benefits vary by location.

About R/GA

R/GA is a global digital innovation agency specializing in digital product development, brand transformation, media, and communications for major companies. We are on a mission to help companies grow by enabling them to change, across their business, the experience they offer and the campaigns that take them to market.

Our work tends to be a fusion of what we call Stories and Systems: the narrative and the design, technology and the interface working together. R/GA is a brand but it's also a collective of atypical outsiders and misfits who drive everything we do through bold creativity and bright, strategic thinking.

About the role

Our Designers are makers and storytellers that use design to bring ideas to life. They lead projects into uncharted creative territories and create new outcomes. They design fundamentalists, but approach projects with a systems and stories mindset. They identify user needs, interpret client challenges, create innovative concepts and define visual language.

We are looking for a Visual Designer to join the R/GA Marketing and Communications team. This person will play an integral role in how R/GA is shown to the world, designing everything from the content. Right down to quarterly reports and data visualizations for proprietary thought leadership. They will work closely with the brand marketing team, including the senior visual designer, to define R/GA's visual identity across owned channels and guide the implementation and evolution of our external and internal branding.

Here’s what you should know if you want to be aVisual Designer at R/GA:

On any given day you might

  • Define concepts and visual narratives that are grounded in strategy and culture.
  • Create designs such as user interface, layouts, brand identity and iconography to a high standard
  • Contribute to the creation and definition of flexible design systems and visual languages
  • Define art direction and evolve existing visual centers and guidelines
  • Work closely with the Design Director and CD to push the design craft and execute the creative vision.
  • Take an active part in presentations
  • Explain and articulate design decisions and rationale with confidence
  • Has an equal mix of conceptual thinking and design craft.
  • Is able to create and craft innovative award winning work.
  • Is able to work across more than one project and effectively manage their time.
  • Has a sharp eye for design and excellent attention to detail.
  • Has a proven track record in both systematic and campaign work.
  • Has experience with motion design.
  • Has an active creative and cultural life.

The ideal person

  • Not just a stellar designer but a team player looking to take the next step in your career. You are confident working with clients and other disciplines to create work that hasn’t been done before.
  • A world-class designer with impeccable craft and flair, comfortably and consistently superb in your execution across a range of visual styles and mediums. Able to define creative concepts around systematic thinking, story-telling and campaign thinking, always with a view to how these resonate with youth culture.
  • Proactive and positive in your approach to the work and the team around you.
  • A collaborator. You will collaborate closely with our strategy, design, production and creative teams to ensure innovative outcomes.
  • Hungry to continue improving your craft and fast-track your career.
  • Interested in more than design. You understand how to create work that resonates in youth culture and beyond.
  • A natural communicator. You are confident and articulate expressing yourself in verbal and written form.

You bring

  • 3+ years agency or similar experience.
  • Bachelor's degree in Graphic Design, or equivalent education and experience.
  • Advanced command of Adobe Creative Suite, Figma and Keynote.
  • Advanced level of English.
  • Animation and motion graphics experience.
  • Experience in working with Art Directors or Art Direction briefs.

About Northbeam

Northbeam is building the world's most advanced marketing intelligence platform, providing top eCommerce brands a unified view of their business data through powerful attribution modeling and customizable dashboards. Our technology helps customers accurately track ad spend, understand the full customer journey, and drive profitable growth. Machine learning has been at the heart of Northbeam since day one: our full suite of measurement, spanning multi-touch attribution, MMM+, and incrementality, is built on it, along with laser-accurate first-party data. Now we're taking that foundation further, using AI to help brands operationalize their data and turn Northbeam insights into automated decisions.

We're experiencing rapid growth, have strong product-market fit, and are looking for the right people to help us scale. This is a rare chance to make a meaningful impact at a fast-moving, high-growth company. At Northbeam, you'll join a team of driven, collaborative, and talented individuals who value personal growth and excellence. We'd love for you to be part of our journey.

We're a remote-friendly company with physical offices in San Francisco and Los Angeles.

About the Role

We think about our product more broadly than most: Northbeam isn't only a web app. It's our data and our recommendations, delivered wherever our customers already work. Sometimes that's our platform. Sometimes it's an alert that lands in their inbox and shapes their day. Sometimes it's our data flowing into their own systems, or back into the ad platforms to make those platforms smarter. All of that is Northbeam, and all of it has to be designed.

As Senior UX Visual Designer, you'll be the person who makes it look like the best product in its category. Projects here start with our SMEs (our Media Strategists, CEO, Data Scientists and Engineers) and product team, who define requirements and work on an initial concept. You take it from there — fleshing it out, resolving the details, and bringing a level of visual craft that makes dense analytical software genuinely delightful to use. You'll work alongside product, media strategists, data science and engineering to ship.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role reporting to our Chief Product and Design Officer.

What You'll Work On

  • AI inside the product. Automated alerts that tell a marketer what needs attention before they ask, and interfaces where customers can shape their own views and pages through natural language. These are new surfaces that need a visual language invented for them.
  • Incrementality. Making causal measurement feel approachable to someone who isn't a statistician through engaging and beautiful visualizations.
  • Actionable Data Insights. A coherent visual experience across our web app, mobile, email, and the integrations that push our data into our customers' own tools and workflows.
  • The core data platform. Complex, data-heavy interfaces that stay elegant as we add new capabilities for our customers.

Your Impact

  • Take initial concepts from our subject matter experts and product team and develop them into resolved, high-fidelity design.
  • Raise the visual bar across the platform — typography, color, layout, density, and the details that separate good software from forgettable software.
  • Build and extend our design system so quality scales beyond any one screen.
  • Design data visualizations that make complicated numbers immediately readable.
  • Present work clearly to customers and executives, and give and receive critique well.
  • Partner closely with our brand and marketing team on a coherent visual identity.

What You Bring

  • 7+ years of product design experience, with solid B2B SaaS and enterprise work.
  • A visually outstanding portfolio. We want to see your finished work that you’ve shipped with real command of typography, color, layout, and hierarchy.
  • Real experience with complex, data-dense interfaces, including data visualization.
  • Experience building or substantially shaping a design system.
  • Experience taking a rough concept and making it visually exceptional
  • Expert command of Figma and adjacent design tools.
  • Experience using AI to expedite design processes and to enable SMEs across the organization to build designs to spec.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills, including giving and receiving critique.

Nice to Have

  • Marketing, advertising, or eCommerce domain experience.
  • A background that brings craft and playfulness to utility software — game design, motion, entertainment, or a formal art/design education.
  • Motion design and interaction work.
Base Salary Range
$185,000—$210,000 USD

Actual compensation may vary based on experience, skills, and location.

In addition to your base salary, we offer an equity package, comprehensive healthcare benefits (medical, dental, and vision), and a 401(k) plan. Our team enjoys a flexible PTO policy, 12 company-paid holidays, and 12 weeks of paid parental leave. We also provide a $500 work-from-home stipend to support your remote setup.

Interview Process
The interview process varies by role but typically begins with a 30-minute interview with a Northbeam recruiter, followed by a video interview with the hiring manager. Next, candidates complete a role-specific video interview followed by video or onsite interviews with several team members. The final step is a video interview with our CEO/Co-founder. The entire interview process is usually 5-7 interviews total and requires around 5-8 hours of your time.

We accept applications on an ongoing basis.

Studio Science is seeking a Senior Visual Communication Designer who combines strategic thinking with exceptional hands-on craft to help leading brands communicate clearly, consistently, and effectively.

In this role you’ll work directly with enterprise clients to understand communication challenges, recommend thoughtful design solutions, and execute high-quality work across go-to-market materials including presentations, reports, videos, campaigns, and other branded communications.

This is a hands-on design role. Some projects will require concept development and helping clients determine the right approach; others will involve creating and adapting a high volume of assets within established brand systems. You should be energized by both.

We’re looking for someone who can think beyond the immediate design request, communicate confidently with clients, and bring senior-level judgment and consultation to the work - while still wanting to personally execute the details.

**Portfolio required: Please include a portfolio with your resume. Applications without a portfolio will not be considered.**

Responsibilities

  • Translate business objectives and complex ideas into clear, compelling visual communications
  • Partner directly with clients to understand their needs, recommend solutions, and explain the rationale behind design decisions
  • Design and deliver presentations, reports, marketing and campaign assets, and other branded communications
  • Work effectively within established brand systems while identifying opportunities to elevate the work
  • Move comfortably between strategic/conceptual assignments and detailed, production-heavy execution
  • Collaborate across disciplines while maintaining a high standard of craft, accuracy, and consistency
  • Use AI and emerging creative tools thoughtfully to improve the quality and efficiency of the work

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or better in Design, fine arts or a related area of study; combination of education and technical experience is also acceptable
  • Portfolio demonstrating exceptional visual design and communication skills across brand and marketing applications
  • Strong conceptual, typography, layout, composition, and information-design skills
  • Experience designing within established brand systems, ideally for large or complex organizations
  • Ability to understand the business/communication problem behind a request and recommend an appropriate design solution
  • Strong hands-on craft and a genuine desire to personally execute the work
  • Experience working directly with clients and presenting design rationale and recommendations
  • Advanced proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite and Figma, with strong presentation design capabilities in PowerPoint, Google Slides, and/or Keynote
